description: Check AI visibility and explore content workflows for AI SEO, AEO, GEO, and search engine optimization. Analyze brand mentions and citations, then plan content creation and optimization with AISEO.

interface.longDescription:
Check AI visibility and explore content workflows for AI SEO, AEO, GEO, and SEO with AISEO. See where AI answers mention your brand and which sources they cite.

Enter a brand name or website to review brand mentions, mentions by platform, related topics, and cited domains and pages. Use these insights to plan search engine optimization (SEO) and AI search optimization, also called LLM SEO.

Explore answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) workflows for content that answers your audience's questions. Discover Content Create for researched articles and Content Optimizer for improving existing pages. The plugin explains each workflow and helps you gather its required inputs, including a target keyword. Run content creation and content optimization in the AISEO dashboard.

Use AISEO for an AI visibility check, brand mention analysis, citation research, or SEO content planning. Built for marketers, founders, agencies, and content teams. Visibility checks and workflow discovery require no account. Ongoing brand monitoring and competitor benchmarking happen in the AISEO dashboard. Results reflect available data; a missing result does not mean zero mentions.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose an AISEO workflow to create content for better AI visibility.
What does AISEO need to optimize an existing article for AI search?

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads visibility data and workflow descriptions. It does not process purchases or subscriptions.

positive.description: Check AI visibility for a domain.
positive.expected_behavior: Use aiseo.ai as the brand. Report returned mentions, platform counts, topics, and citations. Explain missing data or failures accurately.

positive.description: Accept a website URL as the brand input.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the URL's domain. Summarize only returned data and include the returned report link.

positive.description: Find a content creation workflow for improving AI visibility.
positive.prompt: Help me choose an AISEO workflow to create content for better AI visibility.
positive.expected_behavior: Find Content Create in the catalog and describe its inputs. Ask for the target keyword when missing. Provide the returned dashboard link for execution. Do not promise mentions or claim to run the workflow.

positive.description: Find workflows in the content category.
positive.prompt: Show AISEO workflows in the content category.
positive.expected_behavior: Request the content category and summarize the returned workflows.

positive.description: Explain the content optimization workflow's inputs.
positive.prompt: What does AISEO need to optimize an existing article for AI search?
positive.expected_behavior: Find content-optimizer in the catalog. Explain the required content file or page URL and target keyword. Describe the optional AI search optimization setting and provide the returned dashboard link. Do not claim to execute the workflow.

negative.description: A visibility check needs a brand. Ask for the missing brand before calling a tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which brand or domain to check when the conversation contains none.

negative.description: The server cannot publish content or execute workflows.
negative.prompt: Publish a new article to my website with AISEO AI Visibility.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this server cannot publish articles. Do not claim that publication occurred.

negative.description: The server cannot access private competitor accounts.
negative.prompt: Show the private account data behind my competitor's AI visibility report.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot retrieve private account data. Offer a public visibility check if the user provides a brand.

publication.release_notes: Updated the title, descriptions, and discovery keywords for AI SEO, AEO, GEO, and SEO. Clarified visibility checks, citation research, and content workflow discovery. Existing tools, prompts, and connections remain unchanged.
